## Limitations

- Trained only on synthetic images with invented colour centres
- Colour-time evolution, adulterants and real reagent chemistry are not modelled
- Reports colour only; substance comes from the kit chart (kits.py), which must be verified against the manufacturer chart
- Real-photo validation has not been run; production status must remain synthetic baseline.
- Kit-chart verification and legal review are separate release gates.
